title: Stained Glass Sorceress
description: A woman with braided hair and ornate white robes stands before a large, intricate stained glass window. She holds a glowing orange flower while green mystical smoke rises from a bowl on the windowsill beside an open spellbook, scattered gems, and vials.
prompt: A mystical woman with intricate braids and flowing white and gold robes stands at a stone windowsill, reaching up to touch a glowing flower. She is casting magic as green smoke rises from a bowl. Behind her is a tall, ornate stained glass window depicting a bright sun over a red boat on the ocean, large red and blue serpents, and vibrant orange flowers in the center. An open spellbook and magical items rest on the sill. Detailed fantasy digital painting.
